conflicts.description: The operations manual prints Left Slingshot Spotlight at 18B and Right at 28B. PinMAME's complete machine lamp-test walk reports the opposite pair: public 15/manual 18B is Right and public 31/manual 28B is Left. The canonical labels follow the measured machine test.
conflicts.rationale: The discrepancy is fully resolved for recreation by the machine test; retaining it documents why the runtime-correct labels intentionally differ from the printed grid.

mechanisms.behavior: Stock assembly exposes a jam opto followed by four ball-position optos; the trough-eject coil feeds the shooter lane. Later firmware can use optional fifth and sixth ball optos, but their exact physical expansion geometry remains unvalidated.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: The right-popper opto reports an occupied ball and the right-popper coil ejects it; exact launch vector and timing are not yet validated.
mechanisms.label: Right popper

mechanisms.behavior: Separate down and up coils move the single target and the Drop Target Down switch reports the lowered state; timing and startup state remain to be runtime-validated.
mechanisms.label: Single drop target

mechanisms.behavior: A dedicated coil drives the jet-exit post and a normally-closed opto reports the jet-exit path; the exact mechanical sequence remains to be runtime-validated.
mechanisms.label: Jet exit post

mechanisms.behavior: Power and hold windings operate the lock diverter. The manual identifies the assembly and electrical pair, but positions and transition timing are not yet validated.
mechanisms.label: Lock diverter

mechanisms.behavior: Power and hold windings move the ramp; switch 38 reports Ramp Up. Exact startup position and transition timing remain to be runtime-validated.
mechanisms.label: Up/down ramp

mechanisms.behavior: The stock cabinet has one right-lockup opto and eject coil. Later firmware names two optional additional lockup optos; exact expansion fitment and ball-state behavior remain unvalidated.
mechanisms.label: Right lockup

mechanisms.behavior: The shooter-lane switch reports a staged ball and the auto-plunger coil launches it; exact launch vector and timing remain to be validated in a faithful RFM recreation.
mechanisms.label: Auto plunger

physical.notes: Aftermarket knocker kit; the factory manual marks driver 18 unused.
Aftermarket shaker-motor kit; the factory manual marks driver 19 unused.
Optional ticket-dispenser output named by the game device table; not normally fitted to a pinball cabinet.
